en-US.name: Study Buddy
en-US.summary: Ask what's due and get study help.
en-US.description: Connects to your home school-scraper service to tell you what assignments, quizzes, and tests are coming up across Schoology and PowerSchool. Works for multiple students in the household.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Study Buddy what's due this week
Alexa, ask Study Buddy what tests Bob has tomorrow

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Requires a self-hosted endpoint; not for public certification.
